name: surface-reply-hold-at-once
description: The page sends a reply of the surface tab-b and a reply of the surface tab-a after its hold ended at once, and logs the observation line of the ended hold without a held reply.
reason: exposureReply answers the reply of a surface of a window, and the Go producer runs only log and workspace calls without a window.
